row1: c12=1,c13=1 -> 1 1
row2: c12=0,c13=1 -> 0 1
So shape A = [[1,1],[0,1]] (same as 11/01 L).

Color4: cells (4,7),(4,8),(5,8),(5,9),(6,8). Wait row4 c7,c8; row5 c8,c9; row6 c8. Bbox rows4-6 h3, cols7-9 w3. Pattern:

So shape B = [[1,1,0],[0,1,1],[0,1,0]].

r8: c2=0,c3=1,c4=1 -> 0 1 1

Same as B.

r7: 1 1 0
r8: 0 1 1
r9: 0 1 0
Same B.

So shapes:
5 shape A unique? Only one occurrence.
4,8,9 shape B occur 3 times.

Rule remove unique shape => remove color5. Keep 4,8,9.

Output same as input except delete all 5 cells. Need submit grid.
